records.explanation: Trailhead - GB - Search spent about $16,134.35 over the whole period, with daily spend converted to US dollars at each day's exchange rate.
records.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(kd.spend / fx.units_per_usd), 2) AS spend_usd
FROM reporting.campaigns c
JOIN reporting.ad_groups ag ON ag.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
JOIN reporting.keywords k ON k.ad_group_id = ag.ad_group_id
JOIN reporting.keyword_daily kd ON kd.keyword_id = k.keyword_id
JOIN reporting.fx_rates fx ON fx.day = kd.day AND fx.currency = c.currency
WHERE c.campaign_name = 'Trailhead - GB - Search';

records.explanation: Trailhead had the most installs over the whole period, with 34,706 installs summed across its campaigns' keywords.
records.sql:
SELECT c.app_name, SUM(kd.installs) AS total_installs
FROM reporting.keyword_daily kd
JOIN reporting.keywords k ON k.keyword_id = kd.keyword_id
JOIN reporting.ad_groups ag ON ag.ad_group_id = k.ad_group_id
JOIN reporting.campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = ag.campaign_id
GROUP BY c.app_name
ORDER BY total_installs DESC
LIMIT 1;

records.explanation: Across all campaigns, Brand ad groups spent about $0.72 per install, with spend converted to US dollars using daily exchange rates.
records.sql:
SELECT SUM(kd.spend / COALESCE(fx.units_per_usd, 1)) / NULLIF(SUM(kd.installs), 0) AS cost_per_install_usd
FROM reporting.keyword_daily kd
JOIN reporting.keywords k ON k.keyword_id = kd.keyword_id
JOIN reporting.ad_groups ag ON ag.ad_group_id = k.ad_group_id
JOIN reporting.campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = ag.campaign_id
LEFT JOIN reporting.fx_rates fx ON fx.day = kd.day AND fx.currency = c.currency
WHERE ag.ad_group_name ILIKE 'brand%'

records.explanation: The warehouse hides audience counts under 50 installs, so the result came back blank because it was suppressed, not because nothing matched, and the exact number can't be given (reporting 0 would be wrong).
records.sql:
SELECT SUM(a.installs) AS installs
FROM reporting.audience_daily a
JOIN reporting.campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
WHERE c.campaign_name = 'Ledgerly - DE - Search'
  AND a.day = DATE '2026-10-05'
  AND a.age_band = '18-24'
  AND LOWER(a.gender) IN ('female', 'f');
